Market today: The mood for tech and chips is cautious to negative. The real driver is increasing geopolitical competition in the chip sector, with China's reported advancements and competitive threats weighing on AI hardware stocks.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are major concerns due to their leveraged nature, decay, and massive drawdowns. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. QQQ (-4.55%), QQQI (-6.79%), and SMH (-13.8%) are also nearing their stops, reflecting broader tech/chip weakness.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay and consider their viability. Also, monitor QQQ and SMH as they approach their stop levels amidst the negative chip news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged ETFs and respect your stops in this volatile chip environment.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are showing massive losses and decay. Consider trimming or exiting to reduce exposure to their amplified downside.
Respect QQQ, QQQI, and SMH stops: Be prepared to act if these core tech/chip holdings break their respective stop levels (670, 52, and 540) given the sector's headwinds.
